## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 1-fascicle text by [竺法護](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%AB%BA%E6%B3%95%E8%AD%B7) Zhú Fǎhù treats the post-*parinirvāṇa* ritual practices of *guànlà* 灌臘 — the ablution and sacrificial offerings to the Buddha's relics. The work is one of the early Chinese Buddhist sources for relic-cult practice.

**Abstract**

The translation belongs to Zhú Fǎhù's Cháng'ān period (266–313 CE).
